scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @cp2p/web routes:generate && tsc -b && pnpm typecheck:tests && pnpm typecheck:engine && pnpm --filter @cp2p/signaling worker:check
scripts.deps:check: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs apps packages tools && node tools/check-boundaries.mjs
scripts.check:static: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm deps:check && pnpm purity:check && pnpm i18n:check
scripts.check:full: pnpm check:static && pnpm build && pnpm test --maxWorkers=4 && pnpm test:coverage:engine
scripts.ci: pnpm check:static && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm test:coverage:engine && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.build:cloudflare: pnpm --filter @cp2p/signaling... build && VITE_SIGNALING_URL=wss://playhexfield.com VITE_TURN_CREDENTIALS_URL= pnpm --filter @cp2p/web build
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: pnpm build:cloudflare && pnpm --filter @cp2p/signaling worker:check && pnpm --filter @cp2p/signaling worker:deploy
